description: 侧边栏工作区树:按官方磁盘目录嵌套(官方 workspace-tree 语义),可选按名称中的 / 分组(默认关闭,设置里开启);工作区可手动归入项目组(存储驱动、不改标题、可多级嵌套),未分配的收进可折叠未分组块;新会话页的工作区选择器同树。Workspace tree for the DSH sidebar workspace list, nested by official disk folders with optional "/"-name grouping; workspaces can be binned into manual, title-preserving, nestable project groups with a collapsible Ungrouped block; the New Session workspace picker shows the same tree.
